notes.title: Survival Systems & Street Life
notes.content:
[h1]🔥 Greed of Man – Patch v0.8.8: Survival Systems & Street Life[/h1]
[i]Version 0.8.8 | May 2025[/i]
[b]Developed by:[/b] Josh

[h2]🛠️ New Core Systems[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hunger & Thirst System[/b] – Players must now manage food and hydration.
[*]Eat from vending machines or grab a hotdog before it's too late.
[/list]

[h2]🌭 Street Food Expansion[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Hotdog Stands[/b] – Placed in urban areas. Feed yourself, blend in, or roleplay the street life.
[*][b]Vending Machines[/b] – Use your cash for snacks and energy drinks to survive longer on the move.
[/list]

[h2]🏦 Banking Overhaul[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]New Bank UI[/b] – Mange your accounts more easily.
[*][b]ATMs[/b] – Access dirty or clean cash across the map. Surveillance may apply.
[/list]

[h2]👮‍♂️ Faction Gear[/h2]
[list]
[\*][b]Police Uniform[/b] – Now found at the recruitment hub. Use it for deception or duty.
[/list]

[h2]🎯 New Objective System[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Mission Tracker UI[/b] – this new system helps track active jobs and side missions.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Continues!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.8.7 – ATMs, Debit Cards, New Station & Massive FPS Gains[/h1]
I'm Back! Update 0.8.7 expands the world, modernizes your finances, and supercharges performance across the board.
[h2]New Additions[/h2][list]  [*]🗺️ [b]New Gas Station Location[/b] – Fresh layout, clean atmosphere.[/*]  [*]🏚️ [b]Old Gas Station Interior Rework[/b] – Total layout overhaul for better flow, improved lighting, and a more immersive vibe.[/*]  [*]💳 [b]Debit Card System[/b] – Cash-only is dead. You can now earn and spend digital funds. (Found at new Gas Station on West Island)[/*]  [*]🏧 [b]ATMs Added[/b] – Scattered across the world, these let you withdraw or deposit between cash and card accounts.[/*]  [*]🌱 "Take Out Seeds" button added to planters[/*] [*]⚙️ "Take out Inputs" button added to machines[/*] [/list][h2]Performance Boost[/h2][list]  [*]🔥 Major optimization pass across maps, lighting, and shaders[/*]  [*]📈 Testing frame rates improved from [b]30–40 FPS ➜ 80–90 FPS[/b][/*]  [*]💻 Lower-end rigs should see huge improvements[/*][/list][h2]Dev Notes[/h2]
This is just the tip of the iceberg for updates to come, I am now working on the World of Fate rework and Greed of Man at the same time. Should see some cool content for this game and an exciting 1.0 release for World of Fate in the near future!

Appreciate all the bug reports and performance feedback. Keep it coming.
– Nik

notes.title: Gang War Queue
notes.content:
[h1]Out with the Beef System, and in with the War Queue![/h1]
[h3][list]
[*] Rather than the old beef system where you needed to kill other gang members to go to war with them. Now you can simply click "Enter Queue" and wait for a gang similar to you in member count and experience to get put against you by the system. 
[*] This will allow wars to happen much more often and stop farming War XP.
[/list][/h3]

[h1]Other changes and Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Fixed up some bugs with the gang systems
[*] Added police HQ building (not functional yet)
[*] Heavy GPU Optimizations
[*] Light CPU Optimizations[/h3]
[/list]


*I got a decent amount of GPU optimization done, but it seems like we're still getting a lot of GPU usage even on my high level machine. It might be some sort of CPU bottleneck causing the GPU to work overtime. I'll look into it over the next few patches

notes.title: Instant Market Sell
